name: gop
displayName: gop: which AI agents and people can make code run where
description: gop reads a GitHub Enterprise read-only and shows which AI agents and people can make code run where, with evidence per hop and fixes ranked. The gop MCP server over your graph.json, plus the gop triage skill.

graph.title: gop graph file
graph.description: Absolute path to the graph.json written by gop collect (or gop demo). Keep it out of shared or synced folders. gop must be on your PATH.
